parsed.explanation: The 2024 package is state-level threat-framing: it prohibits gender-affirming medical interventions, recognition markers, pride/public displays and trans-affirming gatherings. That creates active traveler-facing exposure if a visitor needs care, attends, or visibly expresses, though the dossier documents no universal border/facility/custody rule or criminalisation of mere presentation, so it is not severe-band. Recourse is weak: gender-identity hate-crime and anti-discrimination law exist but are not enforced, with official data absent and police homophobia documented. Violence around assemblies is repeated (2012, 2013, 2021) and the post-passage murder of a trans model reinforces fear, even though one killing alone would not carry the rating. Absence of evidence is not safety, but lack of documented visitor-specific imprisonment/torture keeps the rating above 0.20.
